description: This file contains shell functions related to Git repository operations, such as creating commits, getting abbreviated object IDs, formatting output for user-friendliness, filtering output, and comparing references. It appears to be part of a larger test or utility suite for version control tasks.

methods.name: create_commits_in
methods.description: Creates commits in a specified repository and assigns each commit's object ID to shell variables named after provided arguments.

methods.name: get_abbrev_oid
methods.description: Extracts and returns an abbreviated form of a Git object ID.

methods.name: make_user_friendly_and_stable_output
methods.description: Formats Git command outputs into a human-readable, stable text by replacing commit hashes, quotes, and locale error messages.

methods.name: filter_out_user_friendly_and_stable_output
methods.description: Filters the formatted output based on specified line ranges.

methods.name: format_and_save_expect
methods.description: Formats the output to prepare an expect file by removing prompt characters and trailing characters.

methods.name: test_cmp_refs
methods.description: Compares Git references from a file against the current references, using formatted output for comparison.
